definitions.explanation: Trees planted along streets and roads for shade, beautification, and environmental purposes. A common feature of Japanese urban landscapes.

examples.japanese: {街路樹|がいろじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{色|いろ}づいて→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧きた。
examples.english: The leaves of the street trees have started changing color.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{街路樹|がいろじゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧イチョウです。
examples.english: The roadside trees on this street are ginkgo trees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{街路樹|がいろじゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何本|なんぼん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{倒|たお}れて→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧になった。
examples.english: Several street trees were knocked down by the typhoon, and the road was closed to traffic.

notes:
USAGE:
{街路樹|がいろじゅ} refers specifically to trees planted along roads as part of urban planning. Common species used as street trees in Japan include イチョウ (ginkgo), ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ (cherry), and ケヤキ (zelkova).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {街路樹|がいろじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{並木|なみき}→並木：00302_namiki⟧ (row of street trees)
- {街路樹|がいろじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}える→植える：01210_ueru⟧ (to plant street trees)
- {街路樹|がいろじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{剪定|せんてい}→剪定：06327_sentei⟧ (pruning of street trees)
